THE SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA
COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO
400 MCALLISTER STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94102
ALMA JEAN CALDWELL
PLAINTIFF (5)
NO. CGC-02-405248
VS.
Notice of Non-Payment of Jury Fees
JUL NIEMIER et al
DEFENDANT (5S)
To: ALL ADVERSE PARTIES
Trial by Jury in the above-named case has been waived pursuant to CCP Section 631(b) because jury fees were not
deposited twenty-five days prior to the date set for trial by the party demanding a jury trial.
As a party to this action, you are hereby notified that should you desire a trial by jury, you have five days upon receipt
of this notice to file a demand for jury and deposit fees in the amount of $150.00 with the San Francisco Superior
Court, Room 103, 400 McAllister Street, San Francisco, CA 94102.
Gordon Park-Li
Clerk of the Superior Court
Dated: JUL-10-2003
By: E. ESTACIO
Calendar Clerk
Form: C003030
Notice of Non-Payment of Jury Fees
 
Certificate of Mailing
I, the undersigned, certify that I am an employee of the Superior Court of California, County of San Francisco and not a party to the above-entitled
cause and that on JUL-10-2003 I served the Notice of Non-Payment of Jury Fees on each counsel of record or party appearing in propria persona by
causing a copy thereof to be enclosed in a postage paid sealed envelope and deposited in the United States Postal Service mail box located at 400
McAllister Street, San Francisco CA 94102-4514 pursuant to standard court practice.
Service mail box located at 400 MCALLISTER STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94102.
Date: JUL-10-2003
E. ESTACIO
Deputy Clerk
